adjusted.title: Adjusted in YAML

leave.title: Leave without saving?

session.title: Sign in again to save
session.body: Your sign-in has run out. Sign in again in a new tab, then come back and save. Your changes stay in this tab.
session.signIn: Sign in in a new tab

local.yaml_not_map: A card is a map of keys and values that begins with nexdeck-card: 1.
